selection_rules: This is an unapproved W01/W06 proposal. source-inventory selected_components, promised_provider_operations and reviewer remain unfilled.
Core required profiles are acceptance targets, not universal per-operation support. Cloudflare vendor execution is admitted only on darwin-amd64.
PKG-CORE-<profile> is a logical selection of complete receipt-owned units. An SDK alias retains the complete native receipt.
Optional and unavailable labels do not waive retained promises; D03 must explicitly resolve scope/freeze conflicts.
Users retain strategy, provider, bus, storage and external-engine choices. Component contracts are not universal architecture restrictions.
This dossier performs no builds, provider calls, fresh-host qualification or approval. Source/runtime/SDK/schema/public Go module versions remain independent.

Capability bundles are usage selectors. Every selected receipt must retain the exact transitive SDK/runtime closure in the dependency map, even when a dependency belongs to an optional capability group. Including dependency bytes does not advertise all operations in that group.
